adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, the refactor changes `calendarReference` from a single reference to an array via `.filter((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"))` and then loops `for (const reference of calendarReference)` to update all calendar events. However, in the merge case (`if (newBookingId)`), it still deletes only one old calendar event using `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));`. With collective/team bookings now producing multiple `_calendar` references, this will leave other old references/events undeleted, causing stale duplicate events for other hosts.
